messages.subject: Lunchtime seminar: W&I insurance market update 2026
messages.plaintextBody:
Join us on 19 February (12:30, Boardroom / Teams) for a corporate know-how seminar on trends in the W&I insurance market - pricing, retentions and the move to nil-recourse deals. Sandwiches provided. 1 hour CPD. RSVP to Knowledge.
